Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All participants related to a patient with familial combined hyperlipidemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has familial hypercholesterolemia (LDLR mutation) rather than familial combined hyperlipidemia, which requires elevated LDL and VLDL/triglycerides. No evidence of VLDL elevation is provided.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No exclusion criteria are explicitly provided in the trial criteria.

Recap: Patient has familial hypercholesterolemia (LDLR mutation) but not familial combined hyperlipidemia. No exclusion criteria provided.
